record.t: Is the Attorney General named in the State of Mississippi's case against Eli Lilly and Company et al. in the US District Court for the District of New Jersey, in which an opinion was signed on 5 September 2025.
record.q: The State of Mississippi, Ex Rel. Lynn Fitch Attorney General v. Eli Lilly and Company et al, (D.N.J. 2025) (OPINION. Signed by Judge Brian R. Martinotti on 9/5/2025. (adc, ))

record.t: Worked with Sexual Assault Nurse Examiners and other stakeholders to update the Sexual Assault Forensic Examination kits.
record.q: In 2022 and 2023, Attorney General Lynn Fitch worked with Sexual Assault Nurse Examiners and other stakeholders to update the 15-year-old Sexual Assault Forensic Examination kits in line with advanced technology.

record.t: Asked the U.S. Supreme Court to overturn Roe v. Wade in Dobbs v. Jackson Women's Health Organization.
record.q: Ms. Fitch asked the court to take the historic step of overturning Roe v. Wade and send abortion policy back to the states.

record.t: Joined four other state attorneys general in filing a 49-page brief with the Supreme Court arguing that a state may prohibit elective abortions before viability.
record.q: “Under the Constitution, may a State prohibit elective abortions before viability? Yes,” state Attorney General Lynn Fitch and four of her colleagues wrote in a 49-page brief filed with the court.
